title: Scenario endpoint: GET /api/v1/properties/{bbl}/scenario — expose the built deterministic scenario builder (flag-gated, contract-validated, offline via injected PLUTO+substrate seams; no credentials)
objective: Expose the already-built deterministic scenario builder (services/api/app/scenario/build_scenario) via a NEW read-only, flag-gated endpoint GET /api/v1/properties/{bbl}/scenario. Rebuild the property profile + rule-evaluation server-side over the SAME injected seams the accepted rule_evaluation endpoint uses (get_pluto_fetcher + get_spatial_substrate_provider; NO Supabase, NO Geoclient), run build_scenario, validate the body against scenario@1.0.0, and return the documented (HTTP status, analysis state) matrix mirroring services/api/app/api/v1/rule_evaluation.py. Flag-gated via a new INTERNAL_SCENARIO_ENABLED config (include_in_schema=False; flag-off returns a generic 404 indistinguishable from an unmounted path). Offline API + contract tests via committed official fixtures. Draft engineering (needs_review; scenario values surfaced verbatim from the trace, never recomputed; published acceptance deferred to G6/legal like the M4 chain).
business_reason: Owner directive D-038 (2026-09-08): build the PRODUCT, not supervisor self-infrastructure. The scenario engine is fully built and tested but exposed NOWHERE; this endpoint makes it usable and unblocks the Compare (Step 3) UI - a demonstrable, no-credential product increment on the live candidate line.
inputs: services/api/app/scenario/builder.py::build_scenario + contract.py::validate_scenario_document (READ-ONLY; the deterministic engine to expose)
services/api/app/api/v1/rule_evaluation.py (READ-ONLY template: seam injection, (status,state) matrix, flag+include_in_schema=False pattern, correlation id)
services/api/app/api/v1/properties.py + the get_pluto_fetcher / get_spatial_substrate_provider seams (READ-ONLY; the offline injection points)
services/api/tests/api/test_rule_evaluation_api.py + committed official fixtures (READ-ONLY; the offline fixture harness to mirror)
docs/PRODUCT_FLOW_AND_AI_BOUNDARIES.md, docs/ACCEPTANCE_SCENARIO_STANDARD.md, PRD.md §13 (scenario contract; deterministic coverage; AI never up-labels)
outputs: INTERNAL_SCENARIO_ENABLED flag in services/api/app/config.py + registration in services/api/app/main.py
acceptance_scenarios: AS-1 confident R5 cap (fixture BBL 1000010100): 200 + a scenario@1.0.0 body whose draft residential FAR floor-area cap is surfaced VERBATIM from the rule_evaluation trace (test asserts surfaced value == trace value, never locally recomputed); cap_label present; coverage_matrix lists all 8 envelope families as MISSING; never labelled verified.
AS-2 split-lot / no-scenario fixture: yields the fail-closed no_scenario / professional-review outcome with a visible reason and share RANGES preserved (never collapsed); no cap surfaced.
AS-3 no-match BBL: returns the documented not-found (HTTP status, analysis state) pair that mirrors the rule_evaluation route's matrix; correlation id present; no invented body.
AS-4 upstream failure / malformed BBL: fail-closed to the documented error state; no partial or invented scenario is ever emitted.
AS-5 contract: every 200 scenario body passes validate_scenario_document (scenario@1.0.0); the full set of (HTTP status, analysis state) pairs equals the rule_evaluation route's documented matrix.

AS-6 flag-off: with INTERNAL_SCENARIO_ENABLED unset/false the route returns a generic 404 indistinguishable from an unmounted path (never a revealing 403/501) and is absent from the OpenAPI schema (include_in_schema=False).

AS-7 offline / no-credentials (proves D-038-R004): AS-1..AS-6 all run under the injected PLUTO fetcher + spatial-substrate seams over committed fixtures with NO network, NO Supabase, NO Geoclient - via FastAPI TestClient.
risks: Surfacing a recomputed cap instead of the verbatim trace value (AS-1 guards this).
Flag-off leaking route existence via a distinguishable status (AS-6 guards this).
Accidentally editing the built scenario builder or the contract (forbidden_paths guard).
